description: Projects CTL, ATL and TSB for planned days with get_training_load's model from the end of `asOf` (default today, not in the future; to plan today pass yesterday). Give each planned day's `tss` (an easy hour is about 40-60, a hard one 80-100+); days left out are rest days; dates must be after asOf and at most 120 days out. Workouts already in the account after asOf are not read: list them in `days`. A model projection, not a prediction. Writes nothing.

asOf.description: Last day counted as done, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

days.description: Planned days, one entry per date.

tss.description: The day's total planned training stress.

name: forecast_training_load
title: Forecast training load (CTL/ATL/TSB) for planned days
